title: Get Bestselling Creators
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202511/creators/bestselling

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns up to 100 creators, filtered by author_type, ranked by GMV in the selected currency for the reporting period ending on date and defined by time_slot.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
date string Y 2025-11-13 The inclusive end date of the reporting period, in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format and the shop's registered timezone. The period extends backward from this date according to time_slot (for example, 7D covers the seven days ending on this date). The date must not be later than the latest available date; when a later date is submitted, the error message identifies the latest available date.
time_slot string Y 7D The length of the query period ending on date. Supported values are:
  • 1D — 1 day
  • 7D — 7 days
  • 30D — 30 days | author_type |string |Y |ALL |The creator type to include. Supported values are:
  • ALL — include all creator types
  • OFFICIAL — include official creators
  • CHANNEL — include channel creators
  • AFFILIATE — include affiliate creators | currency |string |N |USD |Currency for monetary values. Supported values are:
  • USD — US dollars
  • LOCAL — the local currency where the shop is registered If omitted, defaults to LOCAL. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202511/creators/bestselling?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&date=2025-11-13&time_slot=7D&author_type=ALL&currency=USD

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^creators []object List of bestselling creator records for the target date range.
^^rank int 1 GMV rank of the creator.
^^gmv_range string $97000.00~$191000.00 The creator's GMV range for the selected reporting period, expressed in the currency selected by currency.
^^open_id string uACafQAAAABmUU2qon4R0vUYvUVS3QC6CICP2m5A2-wd77j8R9G0yg Creator's open id, use this open id to identify a creator.
^^user_name string creator_example_01 The creator's account handle.
^^nick_name string abc_bec The creator's display name.
^^followers_count int 11234 Number of followers
^^likes_count int 23342 Number of likes
